errors.evidence: The y-axis has labeled ticks at -1, 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, and 13. This represents a consistent interval of 2 percentage points, not '1% or 2%'.
The description omits the asterisk next to the year 2024 on the x-axis, which is present in the chart and likely indicates a projected or estimated value.
The blue solid line ends at approximately 3.5% in 2024, not 6.3%. The value 6.3% corresponds to the constant average line (blue dashed line).
In 2008, the purple solid line is at approximately +0.5%, not -0.5%. The line dips to its lowest point (just below 0%) in 2014, not 2008.
The purple solid line ends at a value below 1% in 2024 (approximately 0.8%). The stated value of 2.1% is a significant overestimation.
